verdict.rationale: Docs describe transaction types (ACH credit/debit, wire with status tracking, book transfers) and basic account data, implying some structured metadata exists, but there is no explicit documentation of counterparty detail fields, rail-specific metadata enrichment, or stable identifier schemes that would let a developer build rich in-product transaction views. missing for 10: explicit counterparty/beneficiary data fields, rail-specific metadata (e.g., ACH company entry description, wire OBI/BBI fields), stable identifier documentation, and any enrichment/categorization features.
